tools.name: find_upload_requirements
tools.description: Look up what size, format or dimensions a photo or upload must be for a specific form: US passport photo size, US visa or DS-160 photo requirements, Green Card (DV) lottery photo rules, Schengen visa photo size, UK online passport photo rules, or IBPS photo, signature, thumb impression and declarati

tools.name: check_file
tools.description: Check whether a form will accept a file, from the file's facts: its real type (from its contents, not its name), size in bytes, and pixel size or PDF page count. Give either rules or a requirement id from find_upload_requirements (with the upload name for multi-upload forms, such as "ibps/signature"

tools.name: make_requirement_link
tools.description: Make a FileFleet link that carries a form's upload rules, such as "PDF or JPG, up to 2 MB, named Lastname_ID". Anyone who opens it can add their files and download versions that meet the rules, converted and shrunk in their own browser, so files are never uploaded. Use it when someone has to upload

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: make_requirement_link · Private data: find_upload_requirements, check_file, make_requirement_link · Public sink: find_upload_requirements, check_file, make_requirement_link · Destructive: find_upload_requirements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: make_requirement_link · Private data: find_upload_requirements, check_file, make_requirement_link · Public sink: find_upload_requirements, check_file, make_requirement_link · Destructive: find_upload_requirements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
